2026.title: 2026 Season
2026.blurb: New year, new draft, same circus. First installment is up — portraits and the full recap are coming.

posts.title: 2026 Post Draft Rankings
blocks:
Welcome back to the newest installment of "Why Do I Pay Trevor Twenty-Five Dollars a Year Only to Stare at My Phone and Wonder What the Hell I Was Doing When I Drafted All These Dumbass Players." Well, I’m here to answer that, this is the year one of you walks away with two hundred dollars....maybe. Looking at these rankings and where things sit right now, I don’t believe it’s gonna be me unless there’s some miracle of God, and by miracle of God, I mean cheating. Your glorious commissioner, fleecing and finessing every last one of you, taking your best players for the low like this league is a yard sale and I’m the only one who showed up with cash.

I meant to have this out post-draft but life happens and I'm delayed, sue me or dont't read these. That's probably just as hurtful. So with that being said, these are the rankings I had y’all at the second the draft ended, before anybody played a snap. I’m just late, and I didn’t take these first couple weeks into account, so you might be sitting lower than you actually deserve, or you might be floating higher than you have any right to be. Too bad, this is my holy Bible, and it’s what all of you are gonna live by, because these rankings are the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. If y’all can’t handle the truth, then y’all ain’t a few good men.
12. Newpdogg (Olivia)

Holy fucking shit, this team is dick and balls. I couldn’t help but notice while you were drafting that you picked every single Philadelphia Eagle, and yeah they’re a good football team, but when they have a bad week, this whole roster has a bad week. Individually, Jalen, Saquon, Devonta, and Dallas Goedert are great. As a whole-ass fantasy team, boy oh boy are you in trouble.

Jalen throws hella picks, and nowhere close to enough yards for Devonta to be a top tier receiver. Saquon is a beast and a freak of nature, but the way they utilize him is more useless than birth control at Comic-Con. Thank God you have Bo Nix to back you up, oh wait, he’s just as bad. I’ll give him a little grace since he’s coming off an injury, but he still sucks. You don’t really have a running back two either, because the Patriots refuse to use one of the best players on their team. Henderson is a great add, but he’s not gonna have any use until the middle to later half of the season, when they finally get rid of Rhamondre and his butterfingers.

I do like the rest of your team though. CeeDee is an absolute demon. Wait, what’s his name? Did you say CeeDee? See Deez nuts in your face, ooooooo get fucked nerd. And then Stefon Diggs has been a great addition, I thought he might have a bit of a fall off since he's older and Washington already has a WR1 but boy has Diggs been looking good through 2 week. Wait, Diggs? Did you say Diggs? Dicks in your ass, damnnnnnnn, what a double whammy, can’t believe you fell for that twice. In all seriousness, the rest of this team is actually pretty okay. I think you might be able to move up the rankings. At the very beginning of the year I had very little hope for this squad, and it’s still not my favorite, but I’m sure your Uncle Dan will come in and save the day. Hopefully he is nicer than my Uncle Dan who got only ever got me lube and bananas for Christmas. Still don't fully understand that one, but that's neither here nor there. Good luck out there Swoleger!
11. Blowin' My J's (Jordan)

Honestly, for a team that got drafted solely off first names, this squad didn’t turn out bad. You’re surely not first, but at least you’re not last. It might have been a reach to take Josh Allen early, but he is still, arguably definitely, the best fantasy QB in the league. Your other bright spots are obviously Justin Jefferson and Jaylen Waddle, but the problem is they both have terrorists at quarterback. Jefferson is already on his second-string quarterback in week two, and Waddle just has a bum in the backfield. Things might get better, but I fear those two being your best players is a bit troublesome. You better hope Josh Allen keeps dropping forty-bombs more often than Israel is dropping bombs on Gaza.

I honestly don’t hate the running back situation, being a Steeler fan, Jaylen Warren is always an absolute dawg. The problem is they don’t score more than ten points a game, so realistically, what’s his worth? And while Jadarian Price was a first-round pick and there were high hopes for him, I forgot that he plays for the Seahawks, and they never want to utilize their best running back. They’d rather give it to some bum-ass broke boy from Brooklyn and let him get all the end zone work and all the fantasy points. It’s a busted system, almost as bad as well fair am I right? Price works so hard to get to the goal line only to have this good for nothing foreigner (second string) take his lunch money and get a touchdown. God Price worked so hard for that TD and instead the guy who contributed nothing to the drive got the glory, you hate to see it. Imagine if they knew how to use their workhorse running back, maybe then they’d win a Super Bowl or something...oh, wait.

I honestly don’t hate the bench either. The only problem is half of them are already injured and won’t be back for three or four weeks. Brooks, Tyson, and Tongs are all great players, but I fear they won’t be relevant anytime soon. You’ve got one extra spot on your bench, so I would recommend adding a player, perhaps this guy named Jeff Epps. He fits the bill for the team and he's a REALLY good tight end. However, he's also really good at blowing J's which might be staling your thunder but he specializes in the ones under eighteen. Being that you have to be over 18 to play in the NFL, I think you should be in the clear. Stay tuned to see how my attitude changes toward this team over the next few weeks, but realistically I don’t see you moving a whole lot. I’d say try to work some trades, but I fear you already have all the best players with the letter J in their name, so not many opportunities are likely to present themselves. May Jesus jerk your jubilee junkies and turn this into a winning team. Good luck out there, kid.
10. Jockstraps (Haley)

God damn, bitch, what were you thinking when you made this team? I mean, you have two of the best wide receivers in the league. JSN is popping more pussy than Iggy Azalea in 2016, and Parker Washington is looking like the true breakout in Jacksonville. He’s zesty as hell, and give Karl Anthony Towns a run for his money, but if that boy can get a touchdown, who cares? I even like having Drake London on the bench, even though he’s on the most dogshit offense in the league. And let me tell you, Atlanta knows a thing or two about dog shit, just ask Michael Vick, he is very familiar with dogs and the shit that comes with them.  Speaking of quarterbacks whose name is Michael and their last name is one letter away from being a synonym for a dick, Michael Penix being back this upcoming week will likely skyrocket his value. Granted, it’s already in the hell, so it’s not like it can really go down from here.

The problem I see with this team is the running backs. Montgomery had a great week one, but the Texans are going to revert back to their old ways, and C.J. Stroud is gonna continue to suck more dick than Tiana Trump (no relation), if you don’t know who that is, I suggest you look it up, that woman works wonders. So while Monty had a great first week, I fear that’s the outlier, and they’re going to keep working in Woody Marks and cut into his value and his share. Breece Hall is a phenomenal player too, however, he is tied to a bottom-ten team, and if we’re being honest, it’s probably a bottom-five team, despite them somehow being 1-1, I don’t expect this to continue, and I don’t think the Jets will often be playing from behind where they'll have to air it out and he may go hungry.

You do have the reigning MVP on your team in Matt Stafford, but two weeks into the season this man is looking like he went to the woods with Aaron Rodgers to do some ayahuasca. Week one he took a big old dookie in his pants, but week two he showed up against an atrocious New York defense. Granted, he’s gone two weeks without his best receiver in Puka, so maybe things will turn around. Don’t put too much faith in that though because Puka is on the Antonio Brown track trying to become CTE 2.0. I know I got you kinda low in the rankings, but I think this team could for sure move up. To be fair, there aren’t many places for you to go down, seeing that Olivia who can only name Eagles players is the bottom and Jordan who picked his team solely based off the letter of the player’s name is one up on her. So while it’s not the best team, it certainly is not the worst, and I think this squad could for sure make some moves up my rankings here in a few weeks.
9. Baby Choda (Brendan)

Well, well, well if it isn’t the king of the chodes himself. Looking at this team now, a couple weeks into the schedule, I do believe you probably should be higher. Alas, I’m here to make fun of you, because this was my read on the squad before the season started. So let’s dive in. First of all, this is your first year without your glorious king, Josh Allen. I know it must be tough to have him ripped from your soft, voluptuous, manly, strokable hands. Instead you landed Patrick Mahomes in one of the late rounds, and boy oh boy has he looked good. He’s reverted back to his old habits of sounding like Kermit the Frog and putting his name in the hat for MVP.

Despite that, you have two super solid running backs in JT and De’Von Achane. Obviously JT is one of the best in the league, and Achane is extremely explosive. The only problem is he’s on the Dolphins, who are one of the least explosive teams in the league, and Malik Willis is absolutely useless at throwing checkdowns to his running backs. Interesting that you would pick some guy so explosive as soon as I move out of the house, you must really be missing me, trying to find someone or something to fill the void. Just know I left a little surprise on the inside of your pillow and if you have pink eye I have nothing to do with it. Moving on, I do think the wide receivers aren’t as bad as I originally projected. Flowers might finally have a breakout year and he was a phenomenal choice, the only problem is the Ravens are always run heavy. Run heavy? Yeah that's about right with the girls you bring home, those tortas for sure run HEAVY. All that to say his value is for sure capped. Don't let that first week fool you, he is going to come back to earth, but being the #1 WR in Baltimore that is still probably about 15 points a game. Higgins and Pickens are both the wide receiver twos on their own teams, and while they do get a higher volume than most other WR2s, I can’t fathom starting a guy who isn’t even the best player at his position on his own team. I guess it’s worked out so far, you've somehow managed to get one win. Then again, you were against Gabe, who only put up fifty-one points. That’s like taking candy from a baby, a big 6'4 baby with great hair, a great frame, and a really fat DIC....I digress.

I do really enjoy the bench though. Hubbard has had a really impressive start to the year, and while Rhamondre Stevenson has butterfingers, he still holds some value since New England is extremely stubborn with their running back situation (about the only thing he can hold). Even Worthy had a surprisingly good game this past week and could for sure be of value down the road. This team is definitely going to be volatile and prone to booms and a lot of busts. Then again, that’s nothing new for you, you're used to a lot of big fat busts in an empty, dark room, with the Balatro theme music playing in the background as you top out on ante 6 with a flush build.  Lots of Mahomo meant for this post, hopefully this team can get out there and motorboat some Tets (as in Tet McMillan, the WR for the Panthers) Hubba hubba. Good luck, big dog.
8. Fondle These Footballz (Brin)

We’re moving into the teams that are definitely getting better, and that are gonna make me eat my words as the season goes on. But at the same time, this team definitely has its flaws. Obviously you have the best player in the league, he finishes number one at his position almost every single year and guarantees you a minimum of ten points. Of course I’m talking about Brandon Aubrey. All jokes aside, you do probably have one of the best running back rooms in the league. CMC is a legit MVP candidate, as long as his ACL is okay, and DeAndre Swift has looked phenomenal on the Bears so far this year. I do fear his workload may be hindered a bit, because I think the backup, Kyle Monangai, might take a little work, but Swift is clearly the number one in that offense. Just better hope he stays getting the goal line work

You also have a really solid wide receiving group in both your starters Olave and Watson. The Packers wide receivers are always so hit or miss, but I think at this point Watson is solidified as the number one. Their running game has also been so bad they’d be better off with a Make-A-Wish kid in a wheelchair as their running back compared to whatever the fuck they got going on now, thus Sir Watson has been fed a lot and has been returning his value. Olave as well has garnered some of the most targets in the league so far this year. However, one has to ask how long that will last before homeboy inevitably takes a hit too big and confusedly starts stumbling around and throwing up gang signs because he doesn’t know where he is. Shockingly you have Brock Bowers on the bench and have yet to even see him play so that's yet another promising player for the future.

Somehow, against all offs, you’ve managed to start 2-0, with your brethren Justin Herbert at the helm. I don’t know how much longer you can start him with the way he’s playing, but it looks like Sam Darnold is back this week, so maybe he’ll get a chance to earn his stripes. Then again, who knows., Big Cock Lock has been absolutely balling. Is there some competition there? Is Sammy D a product of the system? Who cares, they’re winning, and so is your fantasy team. The more I look at this, the stronger I think this team actually is, but I gotta keep you humble and keep you in eighth place, because we can’t have a two-time champ before ninety percent of the league even gets a singular championship.
7. All My Opponents Goofy (Maggie)

This team is honestly pretty solid. I realize the majority of the league has a good enough wide receiving core to get my on a weekly basis, but very few people have two absolute studs at running back. Both Derrick Henry and James Cook are absolute workhorses, and they’ll put up anywhere from fifteen to thirty points a week. That alone separates you from the majority of the league. The problem I see though is the wide receivers. Garrett Wilson is a great addition, and New York is going to be losing a lot, so he’ll be getting more targets than a gentrifying neighborhood in Pittsburgh (fun fact, per Capita, Pittsburgh has the 2nd most targets in the world). Additionally, they finally got a gunslinger in Geno Smith who won't be thowing ducks and picks left and right. So while the Jets may be balls, at least he’ll be getting a good amount of fantasy points for mama.

My problem comes with the rest of them. Jameson Williams plays for one of the most explosive offenses, yet he’s an absolute dud. Maserati Marv was one of the highest touted prospects out of college, yet he also plays for one of the worst teams in the league and is dead weight. You’d expect the Cardinals to be throwing the ball a lot, and Jacoby Brisket is basically the Geno Smith of the NFC, but Marv has bricks for hands and has no idea how to get any separation from a defensive back. It's a true tragedy and I can't wait to try to trade for him in 2 weeks. While this is all a detriment to your team, there’s one saving grace....you have four fucking quarterbacks, and thank God you drafted four, because Jackson Dart is already out for the year and Caleb Williams pulled his left labia, so he’s gonna be missing a couple weeks. Now you just have to decide between Danny Dimes, who has yet to put up over twelve points, and Brock Purdy, who I personally don't like. He has never done me wrong or effected my life in any way, he just has a very punchable face. You know the kind, kinda like this one girl you may know. She has some buck teeth and a forehead the size of Texas, her name is something like Olive or Alive, I honestly can't remember, I think I curb stopped her the other week. My point is, fuck Brock Purdy, but you can't deny one thing, that boy has been putting up FAT fantasy points every single week.

We’re already approaching week three and the waiver wire is getting a bit bleak, but you definitely have some room to replace a few of these people, or offer a trade here and there, to strengthen your core where possible. I think this is going to be an extremely average team, and by average I mean slightly better than average. You should make the playoffs, but I don’t know that I see this as a championship roster as is. You’re my favorite autistic autodrafter, and I hope the three times you do change your lineup this whole year will be impactful enough to at least get a W over Brody. I think you’re unjustly 0-2, and hopefully your luck turns around here against Newpdogg. This is your rival week and boy is this rival weak. You better smack the shit out of her, because I got her ranked last, and I’m gonna look real stupid if you lose. Don’t let me down, big dog, Woof Woof, Alpha out!
6. Gay People Can't Play Football (Gabe)

I like this team, and I think it’s pretty solid. My worries come when you look at the second string of everyone. Sure, you have Ashton Jeanty, who’s looking like a stud with Klint Kubiak. Sure, you have Puka, who has yet to play a game, but we all know he’s good for a top five wide receiver season. Hell, you even have Mike Evans, who’s looking like the de facto number one in San Francisco because the substation has already eliminated half their team, Stribling, Pearsal, Demarcus Robinson, almost got Shanahan too, scary times being a niner fan, Mike Evans days are numbered. My point is, these are all great starters.

The problem comes when we look at Quinshon Judkins, who is on one of the worst, if not the worst, offenses in the league (Steelers are giving the Browns a run for their money this year). Homeboy has 50 yards in two games. You have Emeka Egbuka, who was expected to be the number one in Tampa, and he has eighty yards in two games. Then on the bench you have Terry McLaurin, who also was expected to be a number one wide receiver, and he just lost his starting QB and is gonna have to rely on Oregon legend Marcus Mariotta. Scarry Terry is not looking so scarry, he has sixty-four yards through two games. I think there’s a lot of potential for these guys to turn it around and have a better season, but right now it’s looking rough. That being said, the starters should consistently put up a solid seventy or eighty points, and then you just need the remaining players to have a somewhat decent week to sustain a W.

However, we see what happens when the starters don’t have a good week, and you drop a fat fifty burger, which is likely going to be the least amount of points scored this whole season by any one team. Lets just hope it's a fluke and it's good you got it out of your system early, but god damn, what a fucking shit show last week was. That’s gotta just be an anomaly where no one showed up and you kinda got burned because Puka didn’t play Monday Night after eveyone else on your lineup did, so I guess I can’t judge you too much, but I’m gonna pretend that was a Monday night mishap rather than you not switching your lineup. Because if that’s the case, you know I’m gonna have to come over there and beat your dick of! And if you do it again, I don’t know if I can take you myself, you clearly don't respect me so I’m gonna have to get another strong, burly, hunky, sexy man in Jordan to come over there too, and Jordan and I will both have to beat your dick off until you cum….to the realization that we’re not messing around, and this fantasy shit means something. Get it together, big dog and may the rest of your team turn out and stay healthy. I honestly don’t know where I’m gonna put you in future rankings. This team has me in a blender right now, I’m so conflicted whether this is a good team or a bad team, but only time will tell.
5. Baby got Dak (Jess)

Baby got Dak!!! Holy shit, girl, what a turnaround you’ve had in your few years of fantasy. I have you at five, but I think I might have to reconsider in the next set of rankings. The more I look at this team, the more I like it. You have two starting-caliber running backs, and while they may not be the greatest in the league, they’re both good enough to be better than the majority of everyone else’s starters. They’ll consistently get you a decent amount of points on a weekly basis, maybe they aren't dropping 20 bombs, but at least 10-12 is likely on Sundays. Jeremiyah Love has been through some hard falls because Arizona is ass, but at least they’re getting better. The Skattpack has also been really balling out, but in New York they do run a bit of a committee, and he just lost his best friend and CTE buddy in Jackson Dart. Not sure how this affects the Giants offense going forward, whether they run more through Cam or if they’re losing more games and have to pass the ball. But I guess we’ll see in the upcoming weeks. Could be good, could also tank his value.

Then on top of that, you have one of the best wide receiving cores in this entire league. Amon-Reezy Saint Breezy is obviously one of the best in the league, and extremely consistent. Davante Adams is gonna be hit or miss, and I think he only had a really good game last week because Puka was M.I.A, but when he returns, I expect Adams to lose a little value. That being said, he’s probably still a reasonable flex piece, or he could be traded for someone better. And if those two aren’t good enough, you have Rashee Rice, Matthew Golden, and Deebo Samuel all on your bench. The three of those guys are all gonna have themselves a surprisingly good year. Hell, you even have hometown hero, Denzel Boston, who has had an immaculate start to the season. I know he has a sexual predator throwing him the ball, but if he’s getting a touchdown every single week, who cares how many happy endings Deshaun Epstein got? The general depth across this team is PROBABLY the best in the league but I know the RB depth IS the best with Aaron Jones and even JCM or Alvin Kamara, who might not be great individually, but they could be packaged in a trade for better players down the road.

Maybe it’s The Life of a Showgirl, Maybe it’s their love story, and they deserve a happy ending (Not the Deshaun Watson kind). Maybe the Chiefs are just back, but Travis Kelce has looked like a Romeo to Taylors Juliet and he could be giving you top tight end value for the rest of the season. The more I look at this team, the more I like it, and I fear that this might be one of the top teams going into the next couple of rankings. I don’t know if I can handle you beating the shit out of me in this league and your family league. I’m gonna have to figure out some way to sabotage this, because I’m gonna be super butt hurt if you dick me down this year in not one but two leagues. Fuck, I’ve created a monster, I’m weirdly turned on, but also terrified. Is this hot that you’re good at fantasy football? Is this worrisome, that you’re better than me at my own game? I’m feeling very conflicted with all of my emotions and I’m gonna need some time to process this. I’d really appreciate if you would help me out and help me clear my head...and you know the one I’m talking about. Help me with that and you're number one in the power rankings every week.
4. Chrome Dome Clankers (Trevor)

I can hear it already "Man, you don’t deserve this", "Your team sucks", "Why are you ahead of me?", "You shouldn’t be top five". Stuff a sock in it, Daddy is home. I could’ve put myself top three, but I’m trying to be humble. I mean, realistically, I’m probably not top three right now, but post-draft, I thought I had a team of the gods and a real reason to be top three. The running backs terrify me, and I’m hoping that my woman beater, Josh Jacobs, comes back, because clearly he didn’t do anything wrong. I already got a handful of guys on IR, but at least I got Ja’Marr Chase and what could be the surprise QB of the year in New Orleans.

I’m gonna have to work some magic over the next couple of weeks until I get to week six, and hopefully have my totally innocent running back rejoin my team. That being said, the Packers have looked absolutely abysmal, and I don’t know how much of a difference him being on my team or not makes. But I guess we’ll have to wait and see. If any of y’all receive a trade offer that looks even remotely interesting and Josh Jacobs is attached, maybe you should take that. Just a thought. Totally nothing behind that. He’s for sure returning this year, and he’s definitely gonna be a top ten running back when he does. Hit me up, gangbangers.
3. LaPorta Potty Party (Max)

Welcome back to my yearly ritual of glazing you and your team. However, I think this is the first year in four years that it seems I don’t have you in first place post-draft. Do I still like this team? Absolutely. But should they be number one? Unlikely. Especially now that we’re a few weeks into the season, I’m realizing that this team is good, but definitely not number one. Sure, you have probably the best running back combination in the league, and the three-headed monster of Lamar, Gibbs, and Walker. Yes, Lamar is still a running back, but damn, he’s even been doing a bad job of that recently. Bring back Zay Flowers so he can actually get some fantasy points. Realistically, Bucky is a great third option for the three headed monter you got brewing.

Unfortunately, it seems your wide receivers have all suffered some sort of injury. Nico Collins already has a hamstring something or other, Alec Pierce never fully recovered from his ankle injury or whatever it was, Keenan Allen has a DUI, DK Metcalf… I have nothing nice to say about DK Metcalf, so imma do what my mom always taught me and if I have nothing nice to say, absolutely let em' have it! Fuck DK Metcalf, bricks for hands mf, learn how to catch a ball. I saw a stat that he has more drops than he does catches this year. Can you believe that??? Probably because he has been so ass but in reality I just made that stat up. But the fact that you believed that even for a second says volumes about this guy so far this year. He’s on my shit list, and I’m sure you’re sick of him too. But this whole teams wide receiver situation is U-G-L-Y, you ain’t got no alibi, it’s butt ugly. I do really like the addition of Isaiah Likely. While he only scored four or five points last week, he had ten targets, which is better than most wide receivers in this league. Then obviously, to top it all off, you have the GOAT, Chris Boswell. However, he too is on my shit list for missing a couple kicks so far this year. I think the problem is the Steelers are just on my shit list, and anyone Steeler-related in fantasy is pissing me off except for our glorious King Jaylen Warren who can do no wrong.

Sorry to disappoint this year. I know you probably already had the lube and tissues in hand, ready to have a stroke to this team, but this isn’t the year. For the first time in Seattle Seacock history, I’m going to glaze you like Riley Reid on the Blacked couch. Maybe if some of these receivers get healthy again and DK learns how to catch a ball, you might stay top three, but right now I fear that in the next rankings you may be just a bit lower than 5.
2. Like a Good Naber (Katie)

It is a tragedy what your team is doing to you right now. As you can see, I have you as my second best team, yet you are 0-2 through the first two weeks of this regular season. Does your team suck? Did I make a mistake ranking you second? Perhaps, but I’d like to think that I am all-knowing and ball-knowing, and this is just a case of bad luck. In one of my other money leagues, I had a pick around the turn as well, and it was my wet dream to get Chase Brown and Omarion Hampton. I ended up with Chase Brown, but Hampton was gone when it got back to me, and I ended up with Josh Jacobs instead, and we all know how that turned out. I think that was a phenomenal one-two pick. And then to turn around and get both Tetairoa McMillan and Malik Nabers at the 3/4 turn, this was a masterclass of a draft. Hell, you even got Colston Loveland at the 5th, who was one of the top tight ends last year and was extremely promising going into this year.

But I guess we can’t all live in a candy land, and we have to face the realities of the NFL and fantasy football. Drake Maye, who was the MVP runner-up last year, takes a shit in his pants every single time he drops back to throw a pass. Omarion Hampton is great, but he is on a team whose offensive line is about as impenetrable as a piece of Swiss cheese. Malik Nabers is one of the best wide receivers in the league, but his quarterback just busted his knee and is out for the rest of the season, and he’s gonna have to rely on, "Fuck it, Malik’s down there somewhere" Jameis Winston. Tet McMillan too has been out-targeted by the second stringer, Jalen Coker. Is Tet washed or is Carolina just pivoting for the first couple weeks? I guess only time will tell. And to top it all off, your fifth round pick in Colston Loveland has one catch for three yards through two weeks. This guy was supposed to be the next Antonio Gates, the next Tony Gonzalez, the next Gronkowski, yet here he is looking like The Big Lebowski.

So while you are 0-2, I do believe this team can turn it around with a little bit of luck. Please, please, please turn this around these next couple weeks so I don’t look like a complete moron for having you top tier only to be 0-4 when the next set of rankings comes out. Please, Katie, I’m dying. The group is gonna clown me if I have a team that is 0-4 at the quarter way mark ranked as my second overall. Please, Katie, please!!!!! Fuck Brin up this week.
1. Bootyhole Browns (Brody)

Alas, the time has come to talk about number one. Now, don’t get it twisted, this was post-draft and I believed this was the best team by quite a large margin. I’m not so sure that margin is still as large today after a few weeks but you still have a top tier team. Sure, you have Bijan, who is about the only coherent piece of the Atlanta offense, and Penix being back definitely helped, but through those first three weeks he was about the only one who could get more than ten yards in Atlanta. Does that change with Penix back? Does this reduce his role a little? Thursday night football says no, but they were also playing the packers who are gonna be lucky to get 5 wins this seasons with the way they are playing.  Javonte has been underwhelming, but he plays for an extremely high-powered offense, so he should fall into a touchdown every other week.

Then I looked at the WR room and thought with DJ Moore, Rome Odunze, Carnell Tate, and BTJ, this was going to be the God Squad, the'ye all gonna absolutely ball out this year. Unfortunately, it seems those expectations have been curbed and they have all been extremely underwhelming so far, to where you have to start Dontayvion Wicks.
